name: Lin Haiyan
source: Marina is Raina's mother and she raised Raina up alone. She is always optimistic and upbeat. No matter what happens, she is unflustered as she is. She thinks Joe is a keeper, so she keeps a close eye on how her daughter's relationship with him is going and setting them up.
translation: Marina is Raina's mother and she raised Raina up alone. She is always optimistic and upbeat. No matter what happens, she is unflustered as she is. She thinks Joe is a keeper, so she keeps a close eye on how her daughter's relationship with him is going and setting them up.
